headline: New Ideas RFA: Perspectives
summary: SFARI’s New Ideas RFA accepts rolling letters of intent, with selected applicants invited to a full proposal and an estimated four-to-eight-month decision process. It supports new directions in fundamental autism/neurodevelopmental biology rather than routine extensions of prior SFARI-funded work; no award amount is stated.
action_hint: Consult the New Ideas RFA and submit a letter of intent through its stated route.

headline: Simons Foundation Launches $15M Effort To Help Mathematicians Navigate AI Era
summary: Simons, Anthropic and OpenAI announce $15 million in combined funding and resources for mathematics in the AI era. Simons will manage awards, including an announced open call, but the article does not establish a current application deadline or a Simons-only cash amount; the combined cash/resource figure is not encoded as a grant amount.

headline: Simons Foundation Announces New Class of SURFiN Fellows
summary: Simons announces the 2026–2027 SURFiN undergraduate neuroscience-research cohort and paid research experiences. The announcement mentions ninety-three undergraduates and thirty-two returning fellows without establishing that these counts should be added; no award amount or new application window is stated.

headline: Applications Open for 2027 Fellows-to-Faculty Award Program
summary: The 2027 Fellows-to-Faculty call is open to eligible Ph.D./M.D. scientists transitioning toward faculty positions, with applications due January 13, 2027. Its $600,000 three-year faculty research grant is separate from up to two years of postdoctoral support; the final SCPAB participation in this call does not mean the entire program is closing.
action_hint: Review the Fellows-to-Faculty program requirements and apply by the stated deadline.

headline: Applications Open for Simons Postdoctoral Fellowships in Plant Biology
summary: Simons accepts applications for 2027 plant-biology postdoctoral fellowships, due December 3, 2026 at noon, literally labeled EDT in the announcement. Eligible recent or forthcoming Ph.D. researchers may be US or foreign nationals, but awards go to US nonprofit research institutions; sponsor and cross-disciplinary-track requirements apply, and no amount is stated.
action_hint: Consult the 2027 plant-biology RFA, including sponsor restrictions and the deadline’s time-zone wording.

headline: Apply Now: New Grants To Support HBCU Faculty and Research Excellence
summary: Simons Foundation and Simons Foundation International jointly establish two HBCU programs supported by $23 million over five years. Centers of Excellence may serve up to two institutions and Faculty Fellowships up to five, with letters of intent due November 12 in the October 2026 announcement; the joint pool is not encoded as a Simons Foundation-only amount.
action_hint: Review the distinct HBCU Centers of Excellence and Faculty Fellowship program requirements before submitting a letter of intent.

headline: Open Interval Invites Artists, Scientists and Arts Organizations To Explore ‘Turbulence’
summary: Open Interval accepts US-based artist/scientist/arts-organizer trios for its April–December 2027 turbulence program, with applications due October 21, 2026. Each selected trio receives $30,000, at least one third intended for the artist; fifteen trios are planned, and any later project-funding application is a separate conditional opportunity.
action_hint: The arts organizer starts the application, followed by separate artist and scientist forms; allow all participants time before the deadline.

headline: Funding Opportunity Available for Empire AI Projects
summary: Simons announces a $6 million pool for ambitious two-year Empire AI research programs, with applications due December 1, 2026 at noon Eastern. Lead applicants must hold eligible faculty positions at member institutions; outside subcontractors and unfunded Flatiron collaborators have distinct roles, and the earlier $75 million consortium commitment is separate.
action_hint: Eligible member-institution faculty should review the Utilizing the Full Power of Empire AI RFA and its GPU/discipline requirements.
